who: Leader of the Mort Myre group of the Myreque, a gruff, devout Saradominist who fights the Drakans because the vampyres took everyone he loved. He starts in the Myreque's cave hideout under the swamp south of Canifis; over the quest line he moves the group to a cellar in Burgh de Rott, loses nearly everyone at Castle Drakan, and finally runs the Burgh de Rott pub, Myreque's Rest. He wants Morytania free and young Ivan kept safe.
